description: Booked an appointment at Luxe Nails downtown including tip.
Used Uber Premium for both trips, as event had a dress code.
Bought a leather handbag from Kate Spade outlet and had it gift-wrapped.
Purchased full set of Kiehl's products including cleanser, serum, and moisturizer.
Covered brunch at a rooftop café including drinks and tip.
Rented a co-working room for one day and bought name tags, markers, and extension cords.
Ordered 8 large pizzas and 3 bottles of soda from a local pizzeria with discount for bulk order.
Bought chips, fruit packs, paper cups, and printed participant schedules and feedback forms.
